name: exec_shackle_drag
description: Shackle leash: AI throws shackle at nearby soccer ball, then walks right. Verify ball is dragged along within shackle chain distance.
script: # Spawn executioner in H&H mode — both throws held
# Query shackle radius: total * 0.5 (default split) + 20 buffer
# Spawn soccer ball 50px to the LEFT of the player
announce Spawning soccer ball to the left
# First throw: spike ball straight up (gets it out of the way, held by chain)
# Second throw: shackle left toward the soccer ball — should snap-attach
announce Throwing shackle at the soccer ball
# Verify ball stays within shackle chain radius of player
announce Verify: ball must stay within shackle radius of AI
# Walk right — ball should be dragged along by the chain
announce AI walking right — ball should follow
